name: Side Plank from Knees

instructions.description: Lie on one side with knees bent and elbow under the shoulder.
Press the forearm and knee into the floor.
Lift the hips until the trunk forms a straight line and hold.
Lower slowly and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Stop before shoulder or trunk position deteriorates.

variations.variationDescription: Side Plank from Knees — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Side Plank from Knees — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
